% Unit-vector along B
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C6_projector}
\hat{\mathbf{b}} = \mathbf{B}/|\mathbf{B}|,\qquad \mathsf{P}_\parallel = \hat{\mathbf{b}}\otimes\hat{\mathbf{b}},\quad \mathsf{P}_\parallel^2 = \mathsf{P}_\parallel,\quad \mathrm{tr}\,\mathsf{P}_\parallel = 1

% Energy-equation coupling
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C6_energy}

% Entropy production (non-negative)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:C6_entropy}
